content:
[Intro]
[D5]

[Verse 1]
[D5]Hell had you
by the throat You
never got to heaven But you
got real close Your
past has you
in a choke hold But
you deserve it from
what I've been told

[Pre-Chorus]
[D5]Call my bluff say
what you want I'm
looking down at you
from the top I
beg for attention
in small doses
Leave the scene smelling
of dead roses

[Chorus]
[Bb5]Loverboy,
[C5]you
[D5]played those hearts like toys
Don't you feel bad,
[Bb5]don't you feel bad?
[F5]Filled with repent
[C5]

[Pre-Verse]
[D5]

[Verse 2]
[D5]This is your night with
arms wide open
I'm the option you
shouldn't have chosen
Scared of the dark the
door's wide open
This is a night you'll reg-
ret in the morning

[Chorus]
[Bb5]Loverboy,
[C5]you
[D5]played those hearts like toys
Don't you feel bad,
[Bb5]don't you feel bad?
[F5]Filled with repent
[C5]
If
[Bb5]given the choice
[C5]
[D5]would you do it again?
Of course I would,
[Bb5]of course I should
[F5]Well I'm your friend,
[C5]
friends with bene fits

title: Loverboy
